projects.name: MockMirror
projects.description: Instant API Mocking for creating temporary mock API endpoints for testing, prototypes, and demos. Developers create mock routes and fixtures without standing up a real backend. Live product at mockmirror.vercel.app and api.mockmirror.dev. Goal: open-source the core mocking engine and keep a free public tier for Indian and global indie builders.

plans.name: MockMirror open-source and India FOSS runway
plans.description: Six-month plan: open-source MockMirror core, public docs, free tier hosting, and maintainer time so Indian students and indie hackers can mock APIs without paid SaaS. Monthly milestones: month 1 open repo and license; month 2 docs and examples; month 3 free-tier hardening; month 4 community templates; month 5 CI and reliability; month 6 public release blog and maintainer handbook.
